jina-ai-search-reader.free_tier: No key needed for Reader only: 20 RPM (Search is blocked without a key); free API key gives Reader 500 RPM / Search 100 RPM plus 10M free tokens one-time on signup
jina-ai-search-reader.notes: Reader is usable without an API key at a low rate limit; Search needs a key. Interactive docs/playground at https://api.jina.ai/scalar. Official remote MCP server at https://mcp.jina.ai/v1 (github.com/jina-ai/MCP).

kagi-search-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> (v1 API; legacy v0 used 'Bot <token>')

perplexity-sonar-search-api.free_tier: Paid only: no confirmed free tier; pay-as-you-go, Search API billed at $5 per 1,000 requests ($1 per 1,000 for the fast search variant)

searchapi-io.notes: Separate OpenAPI spec per engine (e.g. /openapi/google.yaml); official hosted MCP server at https://www.searchapi.io/mcp (OAuth, or X-MCP-Token header for clients without OAuth).

serpapi.notes: Cached searches are free and don't count toward the monthly search quota. Hosted MCP accepts Authorization: Bearer <key> or a /<API_KEY>/mcp path; source at github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp.

you-com-api.free_tier: Free tier: $100 one-time credit on signup (no card); main remote MCP also has a keyless ?profile=free mode with 100 search queries/day

aws-textract.free_tier: Free tier: for the first 3 months, 1,000 pages/month DetectDocumentText (and AnalyzeDocument signatures-only), 100 pages/month AnalyzeDocument forms/tables/layout/queries, 100 pages/month AnalyzeExpense/AnalyzeID

azure-ai-document-intelligence.free_tier: Free tier: F0 pricing tier, 500 pages/month; analyzes only the first 2 pages per document, 4 MB max file, 1 TPS

cloudconvert-api.free_tier: Free: 10 conversion credits/day including all API features, no credit card required; paid credit packages beyond that; free Sandbox API for unlimited test jobs without consuming credits

docusign-esignature-api.notes: Official Docusign MCP Server (Open Beta, OAuth) covers eSignature plus Navigator/Maestro/Workspaces; mcp-d endpoint is for developer accounts, production via the Claude connectors directory. JWT grant needs one-time user consent; production calls need a paid plan.

gamma-api.free_tier: Paid only for API keys (Pro, Ultra, Teams or Business plan); the Gamma MCP server/connectors work on all plans including Free, with generations consuming credits

google-document-ai.free_tier: Free tier: first 1,000 pages/month free for Enterprise Document OCR only (then $1.50/1,000); Form Parser and custom extractor $30/1,000 pages with no free band

llamaparse-llamacloud.free_tier: Free tier: Free plan with 10K credits/month; beyond that credit-based at $1.25/1,000 credits (1-45+ credits/page depending on tier); 48h parse cache is free to re-query

mistral-ocr-api.free_tier: Free tier: Free plan includes $10/month in API credits; then $4/1,000 pages (OCR), $5/1,000 pages (Document AI); 50% off via Batch API

pdf-co-api.notes: Base URL https://api.pdf.co/v1; credit-based usage pricing after trial; code samples (not formal SDKs) at github.com/pdfdotco/pdf-co-api-samples. Official MCP server: uvx pdfco-mcp (X_API_KEY env var).

slidespeak-api.free_tier: Trial: free API trial, no credit card required; then API plans from $49/month (1,000 credits)

unstructured-api.free_tier: Free: 10,000 free pages one-time to start, no credit card; then Pay-As-You-Go at $0.015/page
unstructured-api.notes: Legacy /general/v0/general Partition endpoint is for prototyping single files; production use should use the Pipeline/Workflow API. Official hosted Transform MCP server (mcp.transform.unstructured.io) parses documents; the older UNS-MCP repo is no longer actively maintained.
